title: SurvTD: Continuous-Time Semi-Markov Temporal Difference Learning for Irregular Longitudinal Dynamic Survival Analysis
core_mechanism: Reformulate dynamic survival analysis over continuous irregularly sampled longitudinal trajectories as policy evaluation in an absorbing Semi-Markov Decision Process (SMDP). Between observations t_j and t_{j+1} separated by continuous duration \Delta t_j, the model evaluates a probability-conserving Survival Bellman Operator decoupled via an EMA Target Network, projects right-shifted lifetime distributions onto discrete support via a non-expansive Cramér projection operator, handles right-censoring via IPCW tail completion, and optimizes multi-step continuous-time lambda-returns under Cramér distance loss.
core_mechanism_steps: Step 1: Encode irregular longitudinal observation sequence H_{t_j} = {(t_i, x_i)}_{i=0}^j into Markovian latent representation h_j via a recurrent sequential encoder.
Step 2: Output conditional hazards h_j(s) over K discrete bins with uniform width delta_s, defining discrete survival curve S_j(s) and probability mass function p_j(s).

Step 3: Evaluate interval duration \Delta t_j = t_{j+1} - t_j and compute interval discount factor S_{\theta^-}(\Delta t_j) using a frozen EMA Target Network \theta^- to suppress Deadly Triad divergence.

Step 4: Shift future target probability distribution rightward by continuous duration \Delta t_j (reflecting renewal remaining lifetime R_j = R_{j+1} + \Delta t_j) and project onto discrete support via categorical projection \Pi: (\Pi \Phi_{+\Delta t_j} p)_k = \sum_m p_m * \max(0, 1 - |(s_m + \Delta t_j) - s_k| / delta_s), with excess mass beyond horizon s_K accumulated into the terminal absorbing bin.

Step 5: Formulate the probability-conserving Survival Bellman target T_{\theta^-} p_j(s) = I[Event in \Delta t_j] * \delta_{\tau_j - t_j}(s) + (1 - I[Event in \Delta t_j]) * (\Pi \Phi_{+\Delta t_j} p_{\theta^-})_j(s), ensuring total target probability mass sums strictly to 1.0.
Step 6: Handle terminal right-censoring at observation t_M (E_M = 0) via Kaplan-Meier IPCW tail completion using target network predictions p_{\theta^-}(s | h_M).

Step 7: Construct continuous-time geometric lambda-returns G^lambda_j(s) via backward trajectory recursion using continuous temporal decay to unify 1-step Bellman bootstrapping (lambda=0) with terminal empirical returns (lambda=1).

Step 8: Minimize Cramér distance loss between predicted cumulative distribution F_pred and target cumulative distribution F_{G^lambda} to guarantee stable semi-gradient convergence without numerical division explosion.

gap_closure.gap: Discrete unit-step restriction (Delta=1) and numerical division explosion (div S) in prior survival consistency models (TCSR, DeepTCSR) on irregular continuous-time observations.
gap_closure.how_closed: Audits the uniform unit-step assumption and pivots to an irregular Semi-Markov transition framework, replacing division explosion with contractive renewal multiplication, rightward temporal shift, and non-expansive Cramér projection.

gap_closure.gap: Catastrophic gradient variance and temporal alarm jittering of terminal Monte Carlo NLL loss across long-horizon longitudinal clinical trajectories.
gap_closure.how_closed: Reframes irregular dynamic survival prediction into policy evaluation over an absorbing Semi-Markov Decision Process, decoupling endogenous discounts via an EMA target network and achieving the optimal bias-variance Pareto frontier via multi-step geometric lambda-returns.

composition_note: Composing assumption_audit_and_pivot with reframe_as_solvable_object is necessary because relaxing the discrete unit-step assumption introduces variable continuous intervals that require contractive SMDP policy evaluation machinery to resolve.
falsification_prediction: When multi-step bootstrapping is ablated by setting lambda to 1.0 (collapsing to terminal Monte Carlo NLL), ranking concordance drops significantly below the intermediate bootstrap baseline (measured in Bleistein2024 as 0.8791 on NASA turbofan degradation) and Integrated Brier Score degrades due to unmitigated trajectory variance.
negative_control: Ablate lambda_return_mixture_parameter by sweeping lambda to 1.0 (pure Monte Carlo NLL) and fixing Delta t to 1.0 (discrete uniform discretization), which disables continuous temporal difference bootstrapping and causes time-dependent AUC and C-index to degrade to baseline performance.
compute_budget: 1x Apple M-series GPU or 1x NVIDIA RTX 3090, training time 20 minutes for 20 epochs across MIMIC-IV Sepsis-3, PBC, NASA C-MAPSS, and simulated ODE benchmarks.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: TCSR is restricted to discrete uniform steps (Delta=1) and divides by survival probability causing divergence; SurvTD operates over continuous irregular intervals (Delta t) using probability-conserving renewal transitions and non-expansive Cramér projection.

CoxSig relies on linear signature regression under proportional hazards and terminal Monte Carlo NLL; SurvTD introduces recursive Semi-Markov Bellman temporal difference learning to capture non-linear physiological degradation dynamics.

Dynamic-DeepHit uses terminal Monte Carlo NLL with an ad-hoc pairwise ranking loss, lacking inter-step Bellman consistency across adjacent observations; SurvTD enforces structural temporal consistency directly via contractive operators.
Bradtke & Duff formulate scalar value iteration for continuous-time SMDPs; SurvTD extends continuous-time SMDP temporal difference learning to distributional time-to-event survival prediction.
